title: Plasma panel suggestions for tablet mode
line: Panels have a new "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" visibility option: they hide in Tablet Mode and stay visible otherwise.
explanation: The reporter asked for tablet-friendly panel behaviour, most concretely being able to have the panel auto hide only in Tablet Mode. Panel visibility was a single mode applied all the time, so a tablet user had to choose between a panel that covers apps in Tablet Mode and one that also hides at the desk. The change adds an "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" visibility mode: plasmashell follows KWin's tablet mode over D-Bus and the panel acts as Auto hide while it is on and as Always visible (reserving space) while it is off, switching live.

commits.message:
shell/panelview: Add an Auto hide in Tablet Mode visibility mode

Panels could only auto hide all the time, so tablet users had to choose
between a panel in the way and one that also hides on the desktop. The
new mode auto hides in Tablet Mode and is always visible otherwise.

BUG: 517517

desktoppackage/configuration: Offer Auto hide in Tablet Mode for panels

The panel settings only listed visibility modes that apply all the time.
Add the new Auto hide in Tablet Mode entry to the Visibility combobox so
the panel can hide in Tablet Mode only and stay visible otherwise.

BUG: 517517

media.caption: Panel Settings: Visibility only offers modes that apply all the time
Panel Settings: new "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" entry
Tablet Mode on: the bottom panel can't be set to hide only now, it stays
Tablet Mode on with the new mode: the bottom panel hides (top panel left Always visible)
Still in Tablet Mode: touching the bottom edge brings the panel back, as with Auto hide
